items.title: Separate inventory critic dispatch from topology proof prerequisites
items.context: Choose inventory-only dispatch only for the valid current OPEN epoch and preserve existing topology proof requirements elsewhere.
items.userSees: An independent inventory critic can review an express Story without an implementer-specific commit; invalid epochs and topology proof attempts remain refused.
